title: Suggestions
body:
Excellent app overall, but there's a confusing experience when adding events from third-party invitations.The calendar page shows a prominent blue check mark at the top, which naturally looks like the confirmation button to save the event. Most users instinctively tap it, expecting the appointment to be added to their calendar, but it doesnt. 
- users must instead tap the smaller
"Add to Calendar" button at the bottom of the screen. The Ul is misleading and can easily cause people to think the event was added when it wasn't.
